name: Content moderation / online safety evaluation (category)
summary: Reviewing posts, videos or search results against safety rules; some evaluator versions are part-time freelance work from home.
whatYouDo: You review flagged or sampled content and decide whether it breaks guidelines, or rate how safe and relevant results are, following detailed policies. TELUS Digital's Internet Safety Evaluator, for example, reviews online video search results, including content that may be upsetting or offensive.
appeal: Independent screen-based work with no live customer contact
TELUS Digital evaluator postings say no previous professional experience is required
Evaluator variants advertise choosing your own hours, part-time
watchOuts: Exposure to upsetting or offensive material is part of the job
No remote Canadian content-moderator posting from large outsourcers was found; many moderator jobs are office-based abroad
TELUS Digital's Canada search listed an 'Internet Safety Evaluator - English (Canada)' role, but its pay and requirements were not seen; the detailed Canada listing seen was Russian-language
Freelance evaluator work: no benefits, hours not guaranteed, must pass an assessment first
US version of the role required 3 years of US residency, so rules differ by country

training.notes: Evaluator roles require passing a standard assessment process (paid/unpaid not stated).

reliability.notes: Freelance evaluator hours are self-chosen but not guaranteed.

applicationSteps: Check TELUS Digital's Canada careers listings for evaluator or safety roles in your language
Read the posting's description of disturbing content before applying
fitsIf: You are detail-oriented, prefer solo screen work, and are confident you can handle disturbing material.
notFitIf: Graphic, hateful or upsetting content would affect your wellbeing.
